description: Snapshot and restore browser state (cookies, localStorage, sessionStorage, and scroll/URL) into named checkpoints to time-travel and rollback failed automation branches.

action.description: Action to perform: 'save' a new checkpoint, 'restore' an existing checkpoint, 'list' all checkpoints, or 'delete' a checkpoint.

app.description: Electron app name configured in config.json under 'electron'.

includeDom.description: Whether to include a lightweight DOM snapshot during 'save' (default false).

name: browser_checkpoint
